inbodydescription.para: Pack one config word per selected detector, then send a single XLoader_ConfigureGlitchDetector IPI. PMC calibration is applied live in GD_FUSE_CTRL, while the ASU and LPD detectors are held in reset by the PLM while calibration is written and released afterwards. Enabling / test-glitch are left to the application (optional TEST_GLITCH_* path below).

Configure the DDR address of the PDI for the next image load. PLM validates the address range and stores it if valid. On failure the address is marked invalid and PLM falls back to the Image Store PDI list.

briefdescription.para: Which glitch detectors to configure via XLoader_ConfigureGlitchDetector.

detaileddescription.para: Use 0 to disable a group and 1 to enable it. Enabled groups are packed into one IPI.0: disable, 1: enable PMC GD0 + PMC GD1

briefdescription.para: 0: disable, 1: enable LPD GD0 + LPD GD1

detaileddescription.para: Master switch plus optional per-block enables (0: disable, 1: enable). Stimulus uses direct Xil_Out32 (no Loader IPI for test-glitch).

Defaults to disabled (0): unlike the IPI configure path (serviced by the PLM), this direct MMIO only works if isolation/protection settings grant this processor access to pmc_analog/asu_global/lpd_slcr. Set to 1 only after confirming that for your design.0: disable, 1: enable test glitch via MMIO

briefdescription.para: 0: disable, 1: pulse PMC GD0 + GD1 (if configured)
0: disable, 1: enable pulse ASU GD (if configured)
0: disable, 1: pulse LPD GD0 + GD1 (if configured)
Shared calibration for selected detectors, expressed the same way as the PMC gd_fuse_ctrl word 0xC4211: Depth = 12, Width = 2, RefVoltage = 12.

detaileddescription.para: The ASU / LPD detection windows are not guaranteed to match PMC, so if no glitch is detected after enable sweep these values. Refer to XAPP1389 for more information related to the values to be written to depth/width/ref voltage.GD_DEPTH_SEL, 5 bits
